subject.title: doctor --fix migrates codex/gpt-5.5 to openai/gpt-5.5, then Codex app-server startup times out on 2026.6.1

question: Should this issue be resolved by retaining unsafe legacy Codex routes through the shared doctor migration plan, and should the Codex startup-timeout PR be required before this issue can close?
rationale: The current code still performs the reported migration, but the proposed fix changes shipped doctor migration policy and the startup half has a separate proof-sufficiency question that automation cannot safely decide.

options.title: Adopt migration plan plus startup review
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/93180 as the canonical migration-policy fix and review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89442 for the startup-timeout half before closing this issue.

options.title: Adopt migration plan only
options.body: Land the doctor migration-plan work first, then keep this issue or a linked follow-up open only if the reporter's smoke test still times out after the route is retained or safely migrated.

options.title: Reject retained-route policy
options.body: Close the migration-plan direction only if maintainers intentionally want doctor to keep canonicalizing these routes and can document the supported recovery path for affected hosts.

recommendation.title: Adopt migration plan plus startup review
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/93180 as the canonical migration-policy fix and review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89442 for the startup-timeout half before closing this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the strongest shared owner signal across current Codex OAuth routing, doctor/runtime selection, and startup lifecycle maintenance.
